summary: Defines new DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 options that hand a client a list of IP addresses and domain names for IEEE 802.21 Mobility Services servers (see RFC 5677). A mobile device can learn where to find those servers when it joins a network.

eli5.summary: When you walk into a new building, the front desk gives you a list of helpers and where to find them. These new DHCP options are that list, handed to a device when it joins a network.

questions: how to find mobility service servers with dhcp
